content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DDMA Yadgir District Disaster Management Professional Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://yadgir.nic.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 02-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DDMA Yadgir District Disaster Management Professional post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the District Disaster Management Professional post is 02 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree in Science, Social Science, Rural Development, Environmental Science, or Management from a UGC-recognized university. Additionally, 2-5 years of relevant experience in Disaster Management is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the District Disaster Management Professional position?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 25 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the District Disaster Management Professional role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 53240 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, and send it along with required documents to the address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the District Disaster Management Professional post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes application screening, shortlisting on merit, an interview, and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job is offered on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the District Disaster Management Authority Yadgir (DDMA Yadgir).

faq.question: Q10. What are the important dates for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application starts on 19 August 2026, and the last date to apply is 02 September 2026. The notification was released on 18 August 2026.
